_comment: The feel of the movement. Every number here is the game. Units: pixels and seconds. Designers: change one thing at a time and refresh.

run._what: Ground movement. accel = how fast you reach maxSpeed; decel = how fast you stop; turnBoost multiplies accel when reversing direction.

air._what: Control while airborne. Lower than ground so jumps commit, but enough to steer.

jump._what: velocity = initial upward speed. Releasing early multiplies upward speed by cutMultiplier (variable height). coyoteMs = grace after leaving a ledge. bufferMs = grace for pressing before landing.
jump._apex: Near the top of a jump (|vy| < apexThreshold) gravity is scaled down for hang time.

wall._what: Pressing into a wall while falling slides at slideSpeed. Jumping off it launches away at (vx, vy) and locks horizontal input for lockMs so you don't cancel it.

camera._what: lerp = how quickly the camera catches up (0..1 per frame-ish). lookAhead = pixels ahead of the player in the facing direction.
